name: Delete collection
description: Delete collection Deletes a collection and all its items. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}

name: Delete column
description: Delete column Delete a column from the collection schema. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/columns/{column_id}

name: Delete collection item
description: Delete collection item Delete an item from a collection by its identifier. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id}

name: Export collection to CSV, JSONL, or Markdown
description: Export collection to CSV, JSONL, or Markdown Streams collection data in the requested format. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/export
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/export
Streams collection data in the requested format. Supports CSV (default), JSONL, or Markdown via Accept header. Queries items in batches of 1000 to avoid memory/timeout limits.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID (hex format); collection_id (path) — Collection UUID
Optional: include_ids (query) — Include item IDs in export (default: false); accept (header) — Requested format: text/csv (default), application/x-ndjson, text/markdown

name: Get collection
description: Get collection Retrieves a single collection by ID with its schema and metadata GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}

name: List collections
description: List collections Retrieves all collections for an account with pagination GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections
Retrieves all collections for an account with pagination
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID
Optional: page (query) — Page number; limit (query) — Items per page

name: Get collection item
description: Get collection item Retrieve a single item from a collection by its identifier. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id}

name: Query collection items
description: Query collection items Retrieves items from a collection with keyset pagination and optional column-based filters GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/items
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/items
Retrieves items from a collection with keyset pagination and optional column-based filters
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID; collection_id (path) — Collection UUID
Optional: cursor (query) — Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Omit for the first page.; limit (query) — Items per page; q (query) — Case-insensitive substring search across all columns. Matches any column containing the term. No relevance ranking.

name: Update collection
description: Update collection Updates collection name and/or metadata. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}
Updates collection name and/or metadata. Schema (columns) cannot be modified.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID; collection_id (path) — Collection UUID
Optional: body (body)

name: Update column
description: Update column Update name, type, required, or position of a column. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/columns/{column_id}
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/columns/{column_id}
Update name, type, required, or position of a column.
Required: account_id (path); collection_id (path); column_id (path) — Column UUID
Optional: body (body)

name: Update collection item
description: Update collection item Update an item in a collection with partial data. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id}
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/items/{item_id}
Update an item in a collection with partial data.
Required: account_id (path); collection_id (path); item_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Create a new collection
description: Create a new collection Creates a collection with four patterns: schema-only (empty collection), rows-only (inferred schema), schema+rows (validated data), or file upload (CSV/JSON/JSONL) POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections
Creates a collection with four patterns: schema-only (empty collection), rows-only (inferred schema), schema+rows (validated data), or file upload (CSV/JSON/JSONL)
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID
Optional: body (body)

name: Add column to collection
description: Add column to collection Adds a new column to an existing collection schema. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/columns
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/columns
Adds a new column to an existing collection schema. Existing items will have NULL for the new column unless a default value is provided.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID; collection_id (path) — Collection UUID
Optional: body (body)

name: Create item(s)
description: Create item(s) Create one or more items in a collection. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/items
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/items
Create one or more items in a collection. Supports single item (data field) or bulk creation (data array). Item data is validated against the collection schema.
Required: account_id (path); collection_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Search items (advanced filtering)
description: Search items (advanced filtering) Search collection items with advanced filtering. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/search
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-one/v2/collections/{collection_id}/search
Search collection items with advanced filtering. Supports operators (eq, neq, gt, lt, gte, lte, contains, is_empty, is_not_empty) and AND/OR logic for complex queries.
Required: account_id (path) — Account ID; collection_id (path) — Collection UUID
Optional: body (body)
